messages:
maria: Heads-up — right after the 09:12 deploy we started seeing a ~4x jump in 5xx for hosted inference endpoints, customers reporting timeouts and billing anomalies. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/example/ingress-errors :eyes:
ops-bot: Alert: 5xx-rate increased from 0.3% -> 2.1% over 3m for service=api-router env=prod (canary-stage). 502s and 504s dominating. Recent deploy: release/2026-03-11-09:12 by eng-release.
alex: copying the deploy - was there any config/flag flips in that release?
jordan: pushed a small change to the sidecar header-normalizer and nuked the prefetched-header buffer flag at canary scope. CL: https://git.redwood/changes/htnr-2245
alex: that header-normalizer tweak was supposed to trim only unused proxy headers, not Authorization. do we have logs showing truncated auth-lengths?
support-esc: customer repro logs (redacted):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...long-token...XYz" https://api.redwood/v1/generate
* Received HTTP/2 stream 0
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"gateway error: upstream returned 502"}
```

sre-oncall: quick check of proxy logs shows a spike in header_count_mismatch and header_truncate events around 09:12:14. sample: `header_normalizer: trimmed header Authorization from 832 -> 64 bytes` — that would break downstream auth parsing and cause 502s.

maria: that matches customer stack traces saying request fails at auth-parse step. billing noise is customers retrying, inflating token usage. need rollback plan.

eng-release: I can roll back the canary selector and revert the header-normalizer patch. Command: `deployctl rollback --service=api-router --to=stable-2026-03-10 -s canary`
alex: before rollback can we patch the config to exclude Authorization from trimming? quick hotfix: add `header_normalizer.exclude: [Authorization, x-custom-auth]` and reapply to canary. less blast radius than full rollback.
jordan: I pushed the exclude list to canary now (config diff below) — testing logs show Authorization preserved in the next few requests.
```
- header_normalizer.trim_whitelist: ["x-forwarded-for"]
+ header_normalizer.trim_whitelist: ["x-forwarded-for"]
+ header_normalizer.exclude: ["Authorization", "x-custom-auth"]
```

ops-bot: Canary metrics: 5xx-rate dropped from 2.1% -> 0.9% in 2m after config patch, p95 latency improving. Still above baseline.
sre-oncall: I want rollback permission if this doesn't hit baseline in 10m. tagging @eng-release for rollback go/no-go.
support-esc: flagged top 5 affected customers, sending customer-facing note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx; a config tweak is underway and we will rollback if not resolved. Will follow up in 15m."
maria: agreed. mute noisy alerts, escalate to infra if rollback needed.
eng-release: I initiated rollback at 09:21:40 due to residual 5xx and customer impact. `deployctl rollback` returned success.
ops-bot: Post-rollback: 5xx-rate back to baseline 0.35% within 3m. alerting suppressed.
maria: good work. action items: 1) rollback postmortem, 2) add unit test to header-normalizer to avoid trimming Authorization, 3) update runbook to require auth-header exclusion in canary patches. assigning to jordan and alex.
jordan: will open PR for test + runbook updates this afternoon.
sre-oncall: leave this thread for postmortem notes. closing incident channel once the postmortem doc link is up. :white_check_mark:
